row.notes: Returns 1 when only one player participates or the player list (+0x2d0..+0x2d8) is empty; returns 0 if the lead player is not in co-op. Otherwise gets the entrant list (vfunc +0x1c8 on self+0x270), finds the record matching entrant_id (id_hi/id_lo), requires Game_OnlineContractNegotiationsV_IsOtherPlayersContractEndingThi for it and then returns whether it matches the player record chosen by mode self+0x290 (1 = first, 2 = second) via Sess_Match_EntrantIdentity_Thunk. Name is a best reading of the predicate.
